cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from tplan import Brute
import engine

# zero drift, zero jitter, zero hop cost: only lineage age matters
fab = {"n":3,"interval_ns":1,"slice_ns":10,"offset_ns":0,"drift_ppb":[0,0,0],
       "heat":[],"anchors":[[0,0,10]],
       "links":[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[5,5],"defer_rounds":[3,3]},
                {"ends":[[1,1,0],[2,1,0]],"delay_ns":[4,4],"defer_rounds":[2,2]}],
       "slices":[[0,1]],"blackouts":[],"guards_ns":[0],"reconfig_ns":0}
prof = {"groups":1,"jitter_ps":[0],"measurements":[]}
plan = engine.op_plan(prof, fab)
print('warmup', plan['warmup_cycle'])
print('ages row0', plan['age_rounds'][0])
b = Brute(prof, fab)
env = b.envelope(0)
w = b.warmup_brute(0, env)
print('brute warmup', w)
assert plan['warmup_cycle'] == w, (plan['warmup_cycle'], w)
assert plan['warmup_cycle'] > 0
for p in range(b.P):
    for i in range(b.N):
        e = env[(p,i)]
        assert plan['bounds_as'][p][i] == (e[0] if e else None)
        assert plan['age_rounds'][p][i] == (e[1] if e else None)
print('zero-cost warmup semantics OK')
EOF
